title: Outdoor Picnic Supper, 1947 Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1947 candid black and white snapshot capturing a group of young women enjoying an outdoor dinner or picnic in a wooded area. The group is seated around a table set among trees, dressed in mid-1940s summer attire. The back features handwritten text reading 'Supper' July 26-47 along with a stamp '749'.
